title: Audit the F9 fixed-vector premise against full-frame transport.
body: ## Change and mathematical scope Scoped audit, no new κ. Selected conditional κ stays `781451/250000000`. On the pinned F9 word `F9-SOURCE-DAG-ALL8-WORD.json.gz` (SHA256 `934fea11e51f674ce2031b7d3127b994a921a9d83317b00359292752563a1775`), every one of the 72 canonical operators `K_G`, in all four signed conjugate variants, fixes the computational zero vector with amplitude `+1`. The full-frame transport `F† K_G F` does so for exactly 8 classes (operators 2, 16, 17, 41, 44, 61, 62 and 64). The other 64 send `|0>` to a nonzero address. Operator 1 is sent to address 48. The scalar observer used by PR5745 leaves rational coefficients unchanged at a warp. That step agrees with evaluating `K_G` on `|0>` and does not agree with the full-frame transport, except on those eight classes. PR5823's immutable `8H8` floor retains the fixed-vector reading. It is not a theorem about `F† K_G F`. The `K_G` statement is a lemma for every invertible 9 by 9 matrix, not a special property of this word. The 8/64 split is the word-specific census. ## Task and overlap Routine session r104, catalogue item #7 in file order: `joint-query-controller`. Scope status: **refined**. The card's first experiment says to audit PR5745 before another free-injection search. PR5755, PR5808 and PR5823 already closed the jointly noisy immutable extension, so this audit takes the premise PR5823 still names: whether the common-fixed-vector specialization holds for this caller. Base: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. The fork PR is based on `cursor/upstream-7c49fe32-base-f209`, which is that same commit, so the diff is this package only. Nearest work: Ali Romman's PR5720, PR5745 and PR5823, and the filtered-native fixed-vector kernel already stored inside the packet for these same 72 column lists. This check does not import `clifford_exact` or that JSON. It recomputes the amplitudes with the quadratic engine pinned by PR5745 and binds the F9 member hash named by PR5720. Open PR titles searched on 2026-11-08 did not contain this transport split. ## Validation Python 3.12, standard library, from the repository root: ```sh python3 -I -B research/f9-fixed-vector-transport-audit/verify.py python3 -I -O -B research/f9-fixed-vector-transport-audit/verify.py python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f9-fixed-vector-transport-audit ``` The direct verifier prints ```text PASS_F9_FIXED_VECTOR_TRANSPORT_AUDIT classes=72 k_variants=288 transport_identity_on_zero=8 transport_nonzero_offset=64 no_new_kappa=true ``` `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f9-fixed-vector-transport-audit` printed `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `completed`. Both registered modes passed. Checks raise exceptions, so `-O` does not disable them. Controls reject a global factor `i`, an `X` translation, and the claim that removing the Fourier sandwich still moves `|0>`. `python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py` returned `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY` with selected κ `781451/250000000`. That command is not a supplier replay. `check_research_commit.py --package research/f9-fixed-vector-transport-audit` passed at `1439ca4204187247689f6f20242fb36c7560696a`. Not run: the PR5745 word replay, the PR5823 dual certificate, Lean, Docker, and `make frontier6030-verify`. `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` was not run. ## Credit The F9 word, the scalar observer and the `8H8` floor are Ali Romman's PR5720, PR5745 and PR5823, following flyingviper's active-mode restoration and the filtered-native packet of Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis and Dugongue. The quadratic engine is the copy pinned by PR5745. The packet's fixed-vector kernel is the earlier `|0>` check for the same 72 column lists. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0. ## Open next questions 1. Can one of the eight transports that fix `|0>` be used by a legal caller without paying a new `H8`? First price one of operators 2, 16, 17, 41, 44, 61, 62 or 64, including its frame change, restoration and target debit. The identity on `|0>` does not supply that invoice. 2. For a nonzero common address, which of the 72 classes still have matrix element `1`? Evaluate `K_G` on one nonzero basis vector before extending the scalar observer. This package treats `|0>` only. ## Workflow feedback (optional) The revision-8 priority prose still names the older #5599 exponent while `certificates/selected-result.json` selects #6030. Pinning the selected record beside the priority prose avoided treating the prose κ as the frontier.
